  • Prey Upon the Weak

    Targets at or below half their HP receive +1d4 piercing damage.

  • Sentinel: Opportunity Advantage

    You gain  Advantage on Opportunity Attacks.

  • Sentinel: Snare

    When you hit a creature with an Opportunity Attack, it can no longer move for the rest of its turn.

  • Sentinel: Vengeance

    When an enemy in melee range attacks an ally, you can use a Reaction to make a weapon attack against that enemy. Target ally must not have the Sentinel feat.

Death's Head of Bhaal is an archetype of NPC that are members of the Cult of Bhaal and are found throughout the Bhaal Temple and other areas during Act Three.
